summary: NASA and the Pentagon faced fresh scrutiny this week over the completeness of their UAP disclosures, with investigative journalist Ross Coulthart pushing back on NASA leadership's claim that all relevant data has been released to the public. Meanwhile, new records obtained by Liberation Times documented repeated drone incursions over U.S. nuclear facilities, including sites near Langley Air Force Base, raising questions about surveillance capabilities and how such activity factors into broader UAP investigations. Astrophysicist Avi Loeb also clarified comments that had circulated online, stating he never predicted aliens would reveal themselves within a 16-day window. The week underscored an ongoing tension between official statements about transparency on these topics and what independent researchers and journalists say the records actually show.
